title: iOS web-contract snapshot picks up the RF-132 likes paging and search contract
acceptance: An iOS PR re-copies apps/api/openapi/openapi.json and the api, schema, authorization and conventions docs from ritmofit_dev_plan/ on ritmofit-web main into ritmofit-ios/web-contract/ using the refresh block in web-contract/README.md and updates its provenance line; the snapshots then document the likes ?cursor= and ?q= parameters and the X-RitmoFit-Next-Cursor header.
The iOS cross-repo parity check passes on that PR, and any iOS wire model that decodes the likes response is reconciled or confirmed unaffected.
